newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Metromail started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Metromail started at buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of Metromail Corp with a buy rating.

-- Metromail maintains a proprietary database of consumer marketing information on over 143 million people, which positions it "as one of the most accurate and comprehensive sources of vital information used in direct marketing," analyst James Pettit said in a statement.
-- He estimates the company can earn $1.12 a share on sales of $321.6 million in fiscal 1997, up from $0.90 a share on sales of $281.4 million in fiscal 1996.
-- Metromail shares were up 7/8 to 19 at midday.
